source: lab (captured, segmentation-style: background replaced by a static synthetic blue-white gradient; SAM2 watermark bottom-right)
units: pixels (image coords, x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static. Replaced background is identical frame to frame (mean abs diff 0.00-0.11 grey levels in an empty region, 0.5-0.9 at frames 3-5 = compression only); both persons' feet stay fixed to <1 px.
camera.intrinsics_lab_convention: focal ~ 0.5959 * 1280 = 763 px, principal point ~ (640, 360) (from the benchmark convention, not measured here)
camera.perspective_cues: No floor texture, horizon or vanishing lines are visible (background replaced). Depth cues: standing person (feet at y=542) is farther than the crouching person (feet/shoes at y~600-615); the basketball rolls toward the camera and down-right, its apparent width grows from 68-70 px (rest) to ~84 px (frame 24) before it leaves the bottom edge; the soccer ball rolls toward the camera / down-left, width 65-70 px at rest to ~85-90 px (frames 32-35, partly blur); the thrown balls grow from ~18-20 px to ~30 px wide while flying toward the crouching person (camera-ward).

objects.name: person_crouching

objects.name: soccer_ball

objects.name: tennis_ball_yellow

objects.name: grey_ball
